description: Election Commission - Declare that Y. M. Jayarathna was Elected as the Member of the Ward No. 05 Bokundara of Kesbewa Urban Council Declare that J. M. M. Roshini Bandara was Selected as the Member of the 01 - Pethispura of Anuradhapura Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government councils (Kesbewa Urban Council and Anuradhapura Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of elected members to fill vacancies caused by death and non-attendance of meetings. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes and declarations for local government positions.
